title: helicia petiolaris var. kingiana
intro: Helicia petiolaris var. kingiana, commonly known as the King's Helicia or Mountain Silverbark, is a plant species in the family Proteaceae. It is a shrub native to Papua New Guinea, and its leaves have been traditionally used in folk medicine. The plant is reported to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Helicia petiolaris var. kingiana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and hepatoprotective effects.
